gates.detector: held-out one-vs-rest AUROC >= 0.70 (point estimate) AND >= 50 held-out positives (v5 floor; fewer is THIN)
gates.repair: >= 50 hard episodes (v5 floor; fewer is THIN) AND Wilson 95% lower bound of rescue rate >= 0.50 AND <= 10% of clean successes lost when the repair is forced on them
gates.targets: ADOPTED if repairs PASS >= 24/28 AND detectors PASS >= 27/28, else NOT_ADOPTED
gates.guarantee: do-no-harm dispatch: threshold lambda fitted by conformal risk control on out-of-fold clean TRAIN queries so that E[Hit@5 lost on a clean query] <= ALPHA; PASS if held-out clean loss <= ALPHA; also report 200 calibration re-splits
gates.natural: report, not gated: (a) real misspelled ESCI queries whose corrected spelling was typed by another ESCI user, gold from ESCI labels; (b) in-corpus superseded policy versions with the validity filter off, no injected docs. Metrics: Hit@5 before, after closed loop (guarded and unguarded), after oracle repair, oracle-referenced closure
gates.unseen: report, not gated: leave-one-fault-out attributor; on the held-out fault test episodes report flagged rate, right-group rate and Hit after dispatch
gates.v2_new_faults: R25, R26, K11 judged with the same detector and repair gates; reported beside the 28, not counted in the 28-fault verdict
gates.v2_loop: family-level dispatch; FAMILIES QLEX={Q01,Q03,Q04,Q05}, STALE={K04,R07}, ENC={R03,R10,R11}; attribution correct if the family is right. L1 PASS if held-out clean Hit@5 loss <= ALPHA under the CRC threshold fitted on the separate calibration split. L2 PASS if mean held-out closure over the 31 faults + C2 >= 0.70 under the same threshold
gates.v2_natural: arms NA1-NA6 on ESCI queries outside natural_exclusions_v1.json; selection by deployed rule only, never by gold; metric paired delta Hit@5 (repair - none) with 95% bootstrap CI (N_BOOT resamples); PASS if CI lower bound > 0, HARM if CI upper bound < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE
gates.v3_scope: headline = GROUNDED set (evidence tier S/M/D, docs/EVIDENCE_AND_NOVELTY_REPORT.md section 2 + v3 additions); QUARANTINE set (tier N/P) is run and reported but excluded from headline claims
gates.L1: do-no-harm, classifier dispatch: Mondrian CRC, one threshold per stratum (rarity x source), fitted on clean TRAIN queries never used to fit the attributor; PASS iff held-out clean Hit@5 loss <= ALPHA overall
gates.L2: mean held-out closure over all faults + C2 >= 0.70 under the L1 thresholds
gates.U1: unseen faults: mean leave-one-fault-out closure >= 0.50 with family-first dispatch + group fallback repairs
gates.N1: natural traffic: deployed loop (natural rules K05/K12 + classifier at L1 thresholds) on ESCI queries outside natural_exclusions_v2.json; PASS iff the 95% bootstrap CI of paired delta Hit@5 has lower bound > 0
gates.G1: grounded set: claim solved iff detector PASS and repair PASS; report count of the grounded set
gates.v5_policies: capped_crc_0.005: Mondrian CRC threshold, raised per stratum to the 80th percentile of the calibration clean score so classifier dispatch on clean is <= 20%; two_stage_0.005: precise rules (alone) or natural rules K12/K05 (additive) then the attributor at a capped threshold, calibrated on the combined loss. Targets reported together: T1 clean loss <= 0.005, T2 total clean dispatch <= 0.25, T3 clean mean cost <= 1.5, T4 mean closure >= 0.80. L1 and L2 stay defined on mondrian_crc_0.005 (L2 bar 0.70).
gates.v6_changes: D1 base-query supply (N_BASE_ESCI 6000 = all examined ESCI queries); D2 C2 pair mix balanced within each split. Nothing else differs from v5.
gates.v5_accounting: VERDICT.accounting: (a) core 28 under the original rule [headline], (b) grounded set, (c) quarantine set
gates.v5_deploy: deployed config: natural-misspelling repair OFF on natural traffic (rep_QLEX not applied); injected-typo repair stays on; counterfactual v4 behaviour reported as h_loop_v4cfg, arms NA1c, NA1d, N1v4
